note: Triennial election of the rural district council (29 divisions), 1927: nominations received by W. R. Bell, J.P., clerk, 26 April 1927. Nationalists, who had abstained in 1924, contested the council again; after two withdrawals there were no contests (Frontier Sentinel, 7 May 1927, p. 5). Returned unopposed.
